from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class Document(BaseModel):
    """A single legal document extracted for classification."""
    title: str = Field(description="The title of the document as found in the text (e.g., '《判决文书 1》')")
    laws_applied: List[str] = Field(description="List of laws or regulations cited in the document (e.g., '中华人民共和国刑法', '中华人民共和国民事诉讼法', '中华人民共和国国家赔偿法')")
    case_keywords: List[str] = Field(description="Keywords indicating the case type or procedural stage (e.g., '执行异议', '管辖权', '国家赔偿', '行政诉讼', '公诉')")
    parties_involved: List[str] = Field(description="Key parties mentioned in the document (e.g., '人民检察院', '行政机关', '原告', '被告', '赔偿请求人', '案外人')")
    dispute_nature: Optional[str] = Field(description="Brief description of the core dispute or legal issue")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Root class aggregating all parsed documents."""
    documents: List[Document] = Field(description="List of all documents parsed from the collection")
